prd_items.note: Backend Content-Length is never copied as a header and reaches the client only as the relay length argument (FR-PROXY-011 statement and AC-5); FR-PROXY-014 AC-1 shows relay called with 10 for Content-Length: 10.

RFC 9112 §6.3 order (bodyless HEAD/204/304 first, then Transfer-Encoding, then Content-Length, then read-until-close) stated in FR-PROXY-014 Rationale and SEC-PROXY-004 statement; stricter-than-RFC rejection of non-chunked codings in SEC-PROXY-004 AC-5.

'길이 헤더와 관계없이 본문 없이 끝난 것으로 본다' is carried by the statement ('reading no body bytes in these three cases whatever their framing headers say') and AC-6; the request table row order (§3.9) is followed and SEC-PROXY-004 AC-4/AC-5 carve these responses out of the framing INVALID_RESPONSE cases.
Single valid Content-Length read and passed as relay length (AC-1); several equal values (5, 5 and 5/05) read as 5 and relayed with Content-Length: 5 (SEC-PROXY-004 AC-7).
Neither header: read until close, relay length -1.

AC-B16 body/Content-Length part: Content-Length and body arrive unchanged (FR-PROXY-011 AC-2, FR-PROXY-014 AC-1). Status 400/404/500, two Set-Cookie, Content-Type presence/absence, hop-by-hop and Connection-named headers, CORS replace + X-App, three Set-Cookie, Vary both tokens, Trailer removal are in FR-PROXY-011; the FIN-early-401 clause is outside this partition's requirement (FR-PROXY-015) and was not re-judged here.

AC-B17: HEAD answered without body keeping backend Content-Length 1234 (FR-PROXY-014 AC-4, with FR-HTTP-037 AC-5 keeping the non-negative length on HEAD); 302 not followed (FR-PROXY-011 AC-1); 100 Continue not forwarded (SEC-PROXY-004 AC-6).

srs_items.note: Statement, criteria and Implementation Notes agree on the relay length: Content-Length value for CL framing, -1 for chunked and read-until-close, HEAD/304 the single numeric value of the SEC-PROXY-003 list parse or -1, 204 always -1; Transfer-Encoding ignored for bodyless responses.
no length headers -> read to close, relay -1.
Request AC-B17 'HEAD 요청에는 본문 없이 백엔드의 Content-Length를 유지' -> Content-Length: 1234, no body.

srs_items.basis: PRD-155; fills: PRD-155 / hole / relay length for a bodyless response (design D-058)
srs_items.note: Request gives no length for 204/304; 204 -> -1 and 304 keeps a valid length, consistent with FR-HTTP-037 AC-5/AC-6/AC-9 (RFC 9110 §8.6).

srs_items.basis: PRD-155; fills: PRD-155 / hole / length relay keeps when a bodyless response carries an unusable Content-Length
srs_items.note: No INVALID_RESPONSE on framing headers of HEAD/204/304 follows PRD-155 and the §3.9 table order; length choice (10 for CL+TE, duplicate 10, 10/010; -1 for abc, -1, >Long.MAX_VALUE, 10/11) matches the statement's 'same list parsing as SEC-PROXY-003 … one value, and -1 otherwise' and the Implementation Notes. Minimal within the item.

evidence.detail: Considered FR-PROXY-014 AC-6 'Whatever framing headers a response to a HEAD request, a 204 or a 304 carries, the proxy … reports no INVALID_RESPONSE for those headers' against SEC-PROXY-004 AC-3 (header value with 0x00/0x7F or obs-fold -> INVALID_RESPONSE, no bodyless carve-out). Not a contradiction: FR-PROXY-014's statement scopes the rule to 'before any other framing rule' and 'whatever their framing headers say', AC-6's examples are all values that pass the header check, and the request (§3.9) puts the header-check format errors '표와 별개로', i.e. independent of the framing table, which SEC-PROXY-004 follows.

findings.description: Possible overlap between AC-6's blanket 'no INVALID_RESPONSE' and the header-check failures of SEC-PROXY-004.

evidence.detail: Considered FR-PROXY-011 AC-5 'the backend's Content-Length value reaches res.relay as its length argument only' against FR-PROXY-014 passing -1 for a 204 carrying Content-Length: 10 and for an unusable HEAD/304 Content-Length. 'only' restricts the channel (never res.header/res.append), it does not assert that every value is passed; FR-PROXY-011's statement uses the same restrictive form ('reaches the client only as the length argument of res.relay'). FR-HTTP-037 AC-6 drops Content-Length on 204 in any case.

findings.description: Whether FR-PROXY-011 AC-5 requires the backend Content-Length to reach relay even for 204 or unusable values.

evidence.detail: AC-4 'well before the read timeout' has no number, but the observable is binary: if the proxy read body bytes from a backend that keeps the connection open, the response would arrive only at or after the read timeout (FR-PROXY-017), so a test with a configured read timeout distinguishes the cases. No failing check.

Design D-058 (00.design.md:116) says 'The proxy SHALL validate the framing headers of every response before skipping the body of a HEAD, 204 or 304 response', while FR-PROXY-014 makes them bodyless before any framing check. The Implementation Notes state the override explicitly and ground it in the request: §3.9 table row 'HEAD 요청에 대한 응답, 204, 304 | 본문을 읽지 않음' precedes the INVALID_RESPONSE framing rows, and PRD-155 says '길이 헤더와 관계없이'. The design only decides gaps the request leaves open, so the request text governs; D-058's relay-length choice is kept as stated.

findings.description: SRS deviates from design D-058 on framing validation of bodyless responses.

evidence.detail: Implementation Notes checked against statement and AC-4..AC-6: 'every element is digits that fit in a long and all elements are numerically equal (so 10 and 010 give 10), that value is the length; any other input (a non-digit element, a value beyond Long.MAX_VALUE, differing values) gives -1, and Transfer-Encoding is ignored' gives 10 for CL+TE, duplicate 10 and 10/010, -1 for abc, -1 ('-' is non-digit), 99999999999999999999 and 10/11, -1 for absent Content-Length (AC-5 304 without length headers), and -1 always for 204 — identical to AC-5/AC-6. Relay behaviour cited ('For HEAD and 304, relay keeps a non-negative length as Content-Length and sends no body; for 204 it sends neither') matches FR-HTTP-037 statement and AC-5/AC-6; the -1 case sends no Content-Length per FR-HTTP-037 AC-5, matching AC-6 'no Content-Length'. Call order after header copy matches FR-PROXY-011/FR-HTTP-036.

findings.description: Round-4 Implementation Notes re-checked; no contradiction found.
